internal_alignment: RL.1.1: ask and answer who, what, where questions about key details in a story (Pages 1 and 2). RL.1.2: retell a story and say what it teaches (Pages 3, 4, and 5: ordering the story parts, the central message, and a written retelling). RL.1.3: say who is in the story, where it happens, and what happens (Page 2). RL.1.7: use pictures plus story details to describe the story (throughout; every story has a scene picture). Every story is decodable from taught patterns only (CVC words, blends, digraphs sh/ch/th/wh/ph, final-e, vowel teams ai/ay/ee/ea/oa/ow) plus high-frequency words. Every answer is findable in the story or its pictures. No prediction, no inference beyond the text, no two-syllable words, no untaught patterns. Internal record only; no standards codes appear on any child page, and no separate answer key is published for this pack.
pack: Kindergarten Reading: Read, Look and Retell: Story Details

pages_detail.activities: Child reads the story, then circles the picture that answers each question. Correct positions vary: left, right, right.
answers: Who is in the story? Sam (the boy)
Where do they sit? In the sun
What does the cat do? Nap
pages_detail.title: Read and Find

pages_detail.activities: Child reads the story, then writes a word from the word bank for who, where, and what.
answers: Who is in the story? Ben
Where does Ben ride? The hill
What does Ben see? A red kite
pages_detail.title: Who, What, Where?

pages_detail.activities: Three story panels in mixed order. The child reads each part and writes 1, 2, or 3 in its circle. Text-based ordering, not picture-only like Kindergarten read-alouds.
answers: Mia makes a big cake. is 2 (middle)
Mia and Sam eat the cake. is 3 (end)
Mia has eggs and milk. is 1 (beginning)
pages_detail.title: Put the Story in Order

pages_detail.activities: Child reads the story, circles the sentence that tells what it teaches, then finishes the frame with a word from the bank.
answers: What does this story teach us? It is kind to share.
The story teaches us to share.
pages_detail.title: What Does the Story Teach?

pages_detail.activities: Child reads the story, then retells it in writing: Beginning, Middle, End. The Beginning box has a starter ("Sam and Kim go to ___"); the Middle and End boxes are open. Small word bank for spelling support: lake, duck, cake.
answers: Beginning: Sam and Kim go to the lake
Middle: they see the duck, it swims, they watch it
pages_detail.title: Retell It Yourself
